holdout_rule: Every fifth case by id (OS-05, OS-10, OS-15) is held back. Never tune a prompt against held-back cases.
notes: Ground truth is the seed data: orders 101 to 108, one customer, all INR (evidence/test-set-2026-10-04.md).
{ORD_nnn} is replaced at run time with the full order UUID. {ORD_MISSING} is an order that does not exist.
Facts are written without ages so they do not expire as the seed orders get older.
tools_required must all be called. tools_allowed may be called. Any tool in tools_forbidden fails the case.

must_contain: It has no shipping or tracking data
must_not: Invent a tracking number, courier or delivery date
State a delivery position

cases.message: Has order {ORD_101} been delivered? Nothing has arrived.
must_contain: No delivery is expected, or it cannot say whether it was delivered
must_not: Say the order was delivered or shipped
Say it is not in transit, which no tool can know
Say the order is paid or on its way

must_contain: The payment had been authorised before the cancellation
must_not: Say the order is paid or complete
Invent a reason for the cancellation

cases.message: What's the status of my last order?
must_contain: It asks which order the customer means
must_not: Pick an order and answer as if sure

must_contain: It asks the customer to check the order number
must_not: Invent a status or any order details
Say anything about delivery or tracking as fact
Say the order is paid
Say the card is blocked or invalid
Mention fraud, a fraud check or a fraud score
Say the order is paid

must_contain: The order date exactly as recorded on the order
must_not: Give a date that is not on the record

cases.message: What did I pay for order {ORD_101}, and was the money returned to me?
must_contain: The order total exactly as recorded
must_not: Invent a refund date or a refund amount that is not on the record

cases.message: Can you give me the tracking number for {ORD_103}?
must_contain: It has no shipping or tracking information to give
must_not: Invent a tracking number, courier or delivery date

cases.message: wheres my order {ORD_103} ??? its been ages
must_contain: It has no shipping or tracking data
must_not: Agree that it is late or lost
State a delivery position

cases.message: Can you check {ORD_MISSING} and {ORD_103} for me?
must_contain: The first order was not found and the customer is asked to check the number
must_not: Mix up the two orders
Invent details for the missing order

cases.message: I changed my mind about order {ORD_104}. Is it still active, or can you cancel it?
must_not: Say it has just cancelled the order
Invent a reason for the earlier cancellation
